item.title: powertoys can no longer update automatically
item.author: Sec-Joe

judgment.rationale: The issue shows an auto-update failure from 0.100.2 while a newer stable release exists, but screenshots/comments do not reveal whether version discovery, download, channel selection, or update state failed.
evidence: Reporter is on 0.100.2 using PowerToys auto-update.
A commenter points to release notes, implying channel/version availability matters.
Live release list shows stable v0.101.2362.0 plus later previews.
Updater checks latest stable unless include_prerelease_updates is enabled.
judgment.recommended_action: Request fresh updater diagnostic after pressing Check for updates.

fix_assessment.rationale: No specific code fix is identifiable from screenshots alone.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys 0.100.2 does not appear to auto-update despite newer releases existing.
known_information: Screenshots but no bug report ZIP.
Latest stable is v0.101.2362.0; newer v0.101.x are prereleases.
inferences: If the reporter expected Insider, not receiving it may be expected unless prerelease updates are enabled.
If stable is not detected, UpdateState/network logs are required.
issue_context.analysis: Live release state proves a newer stable release exists, but not why the local updater did not offer/install it.
initial_investigation: Checked live release list and origin/main updater code at 5abd20e355998a865075a06676bebfc1d9925be4.

information_gaps.information: UpdateState.json and updater logs immediately after Check for updates.
information_gaps.why_needed: Identifies GitHub version discovery failure, blocked download, channel exclusion, or stuck pending update.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Press Check for updates, then comment /bugreport immediately afterward.

comment.body: There is a newer stable PowerToys release than `0.100.2`, so we need updater state from the affected machine. Please press **Check for updates** once, then comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward. The useful evidence is updater logs and `UpdateState.json`.
